title: UN climate talk negotiators go into second day of overtime, at odds over fossil fuels
description: Negotiators at the United Nations climate conference are being asked to consider a last-minute proposal by Turkish officials, an attempt to reach an agreement and salvage the talks that have stretched into a second day of overtime and been characterized by sharp disagreements

title: Green Party hypocrite! Activist calls for end to capitalism while putting on events for fossil fuel industry
description: Jo Dowbor, 27, the co-chair of the Young Greens, describes herself as an 'eco-socialist'.

title: Cop31 reaches a standstill as countries remain divided over fossil fuel phaseout
description: Cop31 reached a standstill in Turkey as the countries remain divided on whether to force a showdown with Saudi Arabia and its allies over the global need to phase out fossil fuels.

title: Fossil fuel dispute threatens to scupper climate deal
description: TURKIYE: Global climate talks dragged into a second day of overtime Sunday as a standoff over fossil fuels threatened to derail a final deal at the UN COP31 summit in Turkey.

title: UN climate talk negotiators go into second day of overtime while at odds over fossil fuels
description: Negotiators at the United Nations climate talks have entered a second extra day in attempt to reach a final agreement to address global warming. The annual summit in the coastal city of Antalya, Turkey, called COP31, was supposed to end…
